repo.name: oras
repo.description: OCI registry client - managing content like artifacts, images, packages

readme.summary: This README provides no useful information beyond project badges and external links, requiring users to visit the website to learn anything about what ORAS does or how to use it.
readme.top_issue: Complete absence of any description of what ORAS CLI is, what problem it solves, installation instructions, or usage examples in the README itself

injection_risks.description: The ApplyFlags function uses reflection to apply flags, which could potentially lead to unexpected behavior if not properly validated.
The createIndex function uses the opts.artifactType variable directly without proper validation, which could lead to potential media type injection vulnerabilities.

security.summary: The provided code sample has some potential security concerns related to injection risks, input validation, and error exposure, but no critical findings were identified.

common_complaints: Authentication handling issues with same registry
Missing or incorrect artifact metadata in OCI layouts
